Now there's no way you're stopping it.|audio = ContainmentWave25-3.ogg|[[Conserver (Narrator)|Corrupted Conserver]] on Wave 25 ([[Containment]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Conserver''' was the second boss that appeared in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It was a corrupted version of the [[Conserver]], making it stronger in most cases. It had a high amount of health though it walked quite slowly. It was also a [[Boss]] enemy, granting it multiple immunities, making it significantly harder to slow down. The '''Corrupted Conserver''' had three abilities: #Its first ability was ''Spirit Release'', which made it fire out multiple skulls from its body. These stunned towers for 3 seconds while also applying a 40% [[Scared Debuff]] for 10 seconds, including non-humanoid towers. Towers would also have ghosts appear out of them. #The second ability was ''Summon'', which summoned ten [[Forsaken Skull]] with a 0.3 delay between each and seven [[Bloated]] [[Hex Revenant]]s with a 0.8 delay, while also healing itself by 1,000. #Its last ability, ''Void Smash'' made it slam its club on the ground, creating multiple thorns that stunned any tower hit for 4 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Conserver's''' body was made entirely out of what appears to be purple molten slag or lava. It wore black armor, which covered most of its body. Its helmet had multiple horns. Additionally, it had spikes seen around its head that resemble teeth. It wielded a black club with neon purple insides, which had three eyes on it. ==Strategy== *High DPS Towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] and [[Golden Minigunner]], are great choices when it comes to taking down the '''Corrupted Conserver'''. You should already have some of these towers placed down by the time the '''Corrupted Conserver''' arrives, which makes it less of a threat. **However, towers that are expensive to upgrade, such as the [[Turret]], are not optimal against the '''Corrupted Conserver''', due to it only giving {{Money|7,500}} per 5% of its health lost. It is also not viable due to the limited space for towers to be placed. ***The [[Gatling Gun]] is also not viable, due to it being disabled in this event by the [[Gatling Gun Banned]] modifier that is applied on the [[Containment]] map. **The [[DJ Booth]] is especially useful against the '''Corrupted Conserver''' due to its discount track, while also buffing nearby towers damage and range. **The [[Commander]] also can be used to give a DPS boost. *The '''Corrupted Conserver''' can reduce tower range by 40% for multiple seconds with its ''Spirit Release'' ability. **This can be partially mitigated using the [[DJ Booth]]'s [[Range Buff]]s, with its purple track providing the biggest buff. **However, If [[DJ Booth]]’s purple track (25% [[Range Buff]]), with [[Ranger]]’s [[Range Buff]] (15%), this debuff will be removed entirely, but however, towers will not gain any benefit from this. *The [[Medic]] can be useful at cleansing stuns from towers with its ability, though it cannot be used to remove debuffs applied by the '''Corrupted Conserver'''. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- !
